scripts.title: Axon Hub  The Animal Hospital Script Auto Work Auto Heal
scripts.features:
The Animal Hospital Features
Auto Work / Full Shift Automation
Runs the full hospital loop: checks in patients, registers them, prints badges, places patients in beds, runs machines, diagnoses illnesses, grabs the correct cure, and applies treatment.

Auto Diagnose & Auto Heal
Reads the patient’s diagnosis and automatically uses the correct medicine for each illness.

Patient Check-In Automation
Handles reception tasks like Talk, Scan Identity, Register, Print Badge, and Prepare Patient.

Machine Automation
Automatically runs hospital machines such as Inspect, Analyze Sample, Process Results, X-Ray, Set Up, and Turn On.

Smart Cure System
Matches illnesses to the correct cure, such as Fever to Thermo, Bleeding to Bandages, Rash to Ointment, Dehydration to IV Drops, and more.

Sanity Protection
Keep Sanity full or auto-use Coffee / Chocolate when sanity gets low.

Anomaly ESP
Detects dangerous entities like Skinwalker, Shadow, Monster Under Bed, Tall Monster, Don’t Look Up, fires, patients, dispensers, and players.

Skinwalker Detector
Highlights disguised Skinwalker patients before they become a problem.

Auto Extinguish & Auto Revive
Automatically puts out fires, cleans grime, and revives teammates.

Auto Heart-Scan Minigame
Automatically completes the heartbeat minigame when it appears.

Shop & Upgrade Tools
Buy machine upgrades, shop tools, and automate upgrade purchases.

Combat Tools
Zombie Hit Aura for zombie anomaly events.

Player Utilities
WalkSpeed, JumpPower, Infinite Jump, Fly, Noclip, Anti-AFK, teleport tools, player teleport, rejoin, lobby return, and Job ID copy.
